name: Fairmont Royal York
positioning: Downtown Toronto hotel on a full block in the Financial District, across the street from Union Station
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base connected to the PATH walkway network
Families or longer stays wanting open-concept Deluxe Rooms or suites

facts.text: The hotel occupies a full block in Toronto's Financial District, across the street from Union Station.
The hotel's dining and bar venues are REIGN, MONOGRAM, CLOCKWORK and Library Bar.
Reign is the hotel's signature restaurant and offers a bistro menu with Canadian ingredients.
The Library Bar is a cocktail den tucked away from the crowds.
Junior Suites have a separate bedroom area and two full bathrooms.
Deluxe Rooms are open-concept with a living area with sofa and a sleeping area, and suit families or long stays.
The fitness centre has an indoor lap pool with a whirlpool, a wading pool for kids, and steam and sauna facilities.
The hotel is connected to Toronto's PATH, an underground pedestrian walkway network linking shopping centers, office buildings, movie theaters and the TTC subway.

highlights.text: The hotel's rooftop is home to over 300,000 honeybees.
Executive Suites have a primary and a secondary bedroom, each with its own ensuite bath, plus a living and dining area and a bar.
Fairmont Gold rooms include access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge, which serves complimentary breakfast and evening canapés.

considerations.text: At prime check-in and check-out times the hotel can get hectic, so it offers iPad check-in, paperless checkout and digital path-finding monitors.
The hotel draws many business travelers, both individuals and conference-goers.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with high foot traffic.
